jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The Corporate Strategy team works closely with Adobe’s top executives and our three business units (the Creative Cloud, Document Cloud and Experience Cloud) to ensure that the company stays on its fast growth trajectory. The team has played an active role in some of Adobe’s boldest and most strategic decisions, such as its well-publicized transition to cloud, and its expansion into a leadership position in Digital Marketing.

Today, Adobe is at the forefront of digital experiences worldwide – be it by giving creatives everything they need to design amazing new content, or by enabling global enterprises in their digital transformation and the creation of experience businesses. This strategy has translated into exceptional financial performance and stock price appreciation even within the Tech sector.

What you'll do

As a Corporate Strategy Manager, you will join a highly entrepreneurial team, including alumni from management consulting firms and experts in digital media and marketing. You will be responsible for managing project teams to hack Adobe’s long-term growth. You might also lead independent initiatives. This position provides unparalleled senior executive exposure and is often the path to unique operational and general management roles throughout the company.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world by numerous “best places to work” awards. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. - 3-4 years of proven track record of leading transformational change with increasing levels of responsibility, ideally in management consulting, consumer internet or SaaS strategy

Join Adobe’s Benefits Center of Excellence team and play a meaningful role in creating exceptional employee experiences through our Leave of Absence, Disability, Life, and Time Off programs. You’ll help design, deliver, continuously improve and measure the impact of benefits that empower our people to thrive both at work and in life. Our benefits philosophy is to design and deliver inclusive, competitive, and value driven benefits programs that enable peace of mind and productivity, with strategic balance between experience, scale, and financial stewardship.

We are looking for an innovative thought leader for t his role , someone who will help transform our Leave of Absence program into a world-class experience and mentor other Benefit analysts on the team. Someone who can m ake Adobe’s Benefits philosophy come alive by leading benefits programs across US & Canada .   This role will be based in the US a t our   San Francisco or San Jose Office.

What You will do
We identify the following primary responsibilities for this role. However, the list is not exhaustive as priorities might vary.

Lead Benefits Program Management

- Support leadership in the execution of strategic goals, multi-year benefit planning, d eliver on program objectives , supply industry best practices, conduct market benchmarking, and help with operational initiatives.

- Develop strong partnerships with Payroll, Legal, Employee Relations, HR Business Partners, Risk, EX/TR Operations, EX Tech, Accommodations team, Finance, VMO and other stakeholders .

- Financial management and oversight of the benefit programs, including overseeing self-funded plans , and annual fringe budget planning . Direct the annual POs process and ensure vendor invoice payment.

- Plan and execute special projects throughout the year, such as request for proposal (RFP) processes, vendor implementations, plan design changes,  and ad-hoc projects with internal business partners.

Compliance & Operations

- Setting up new state plans, responding timely to implementation deadlines, employee communication s and annual notice requirements and filings.

- Track and analyze absence data and metrics, as well as operational trends, workflow efficiencies, service delivery, and program effectiveness.

- Ensure all operational compliance through program audits, employee communications, documentation reviews, Adobe pay practices , monitoring regulatory requirements . U sing an innovative mind to address systemic issues with swift corrective action.

Day- T o- D ay Activities

- Drive resolution on complex leave and life cases, including intermittent leave, extension requests, return-to- work and ADA-related leave requests.

- Oversee third-party vendor management including performance, service delivery, addressing operational concerns, renewals, and all the day -to-day leave administration providing a world-class white glove experience.

- Provide and maintain impactful training materials for managers, HR business partners, employees and employee resource center regarding leave policy and practice.

- Assist answering questions from people managers, employees and HR business p artners, relating to leaves in US&C.

- Support Workers Compensation process by partnering with Risk and Global Security teams.

What you need to succeed

- 7 + years of directly applicable and progressive benefit program management experience in leave administration, benefits management , consulti ng, or case management experience.

- Strong knowledge of leave practice and regulations for FMLA and ADA leave processes, state leave laws, VDI self-funded plan, military provisions, general provincial laws and rights, accommodations, other federal regulations, and return-to-work practices.

- Experience administering complex benefit programs for large, multi-state employer , implementing innovative operational business processes and practices.

- Demonstrated experience managing complex leave cases, implementing business process excellence, providing stellar employee experience, utilizing HRIS/leave management systems, monitoring compliance, and providing operational effectiveness and sound decision-making.

- Knowledge of Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) regulations, ADA, HIPAA, and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing benefits .

- Strong organizational, analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and communication skills, as well as ability to exercise sound judgement, maintain confidentiality with sensitive employee information.

- Strong oral and written communication skills and attention to detail.

- Grounded in magical customer experiences, ability to see all aspects of the leave experience and continually evolve the program to maintain a high-quality end-to-end experience.

- Effective at multi-tasking while keeping calm and energetic. You can do hard things that deliver impactful results.

- Applying critical thinking to a highly complex program, partnering effectively with internal business partners and organizational leaders.

- Able to raise the bar on AI application in the leave space whether that is using AI agents, chat bots, or altering vendors' service delivery model. Having an AI-first mindset a plus .

We are excited to welcome a candidate experienced in building and scaling affiliate programs within of full-funnel, integrated media strategies. jobs.title: 2027 Intern - Digital Strategy Analyst, Strategic Advisory
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The Digital Strategy Group (DSG) works with C-level leadership at Adobe's top customers to craft strategies for customer-experience transformation and digital innovation. As part of our Strategic Advisory team, you'll partner directly with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build the transformation roadmaps that elevate and transform our customers' digital experience.

What You'll Do

Take part in client-facing strategy engagements for customers. In each engagement, you'll join a dedicated team working to solve our customers' biggest digital transformation challenges. You'll work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product experts, and enterprise architects to deliver value for customers. We seek candidates who can contribute in one or more of the following areas:
- Leverage data, research, and industry insights to help customers understand the current state of their digital experience and how their own customers experience their digital platforms

- Partner with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build transformation roadmaps that drive business outcomes

- Facilitate innovation and discovery workshops that bring cross-functional stakeholders together to align on business priorities, surface challenges, and co-create transformation opportunities

- Translate customer goals and pain points into prioritized use cases and a sequenced roadmap for Adobe investment

- Lead and manage end to end execution of new M&A transactions, from pre-close integration planning to post-merger integration execution for all Finance workstreams including defining the order-to-cash process integration strategy, roadmap, sequencing, and operating model decisions required to support deal priorities and value realization.

- Develop and maintain integration-related key performance indicators to measure the efficiency of transaction-value drivers.

- Work hand in hand with Senior Leaders, business and functional leaders to ensure alignment across the operating model, integration approach and organizational structure for each deal to drive execution and efficiencies.

- Drive integration plans, coordinate cross-functional teams, run regular integration meetings and drive proactive issue resolution.

- Build trusted and strong working relationships with all partners.

- Experienced professional with 10 + years of relevant experience, demonstrated success in Global M&A and large-scale integrations, proven ability to lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
The Talent Operations Specialist is a full-time role providing the governance, compliance, and systemsenablement backbone for India Talent Acquisition. Operating beyond day-to-day execution, the role owns end-to-end operational outcomes, process and audit standards, systems and vendor governance, and critical escalations for India TA Operations. At a scale of ~2000 annual hires and 10+ Talent Coordinators, the role provides dedicated operational leadership across a complex ecosystem of Talent Partners, Talent Coordinators, COEs, Global Talent Operations (GTAO) peers, and technology/vendor partners, while also leading key global and India-specific initiatives. The position reduces reliance on contingent resources for core, audit-sensitive operations and brings clear FTE accountability to business-critical processes. The incumbent is expected to operate with significant autonomy— identifying and driving improvements, resolving operational risks, and independently representing India TAO in global forums.

Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Coordination Governance & Leadership
• Lead end-to-end TC operations across onboarding, training, workload management, offer enablement, and interview scheduling—setting operating standards and driving consistent execution.
• Own SLA and performance governance, proactively identifying risks, diagnosing root causes, and driving resolution; escalate only where policy, investment, or leadership intervention is required.
• Lead complex issue resolution and escalations, exercising judgment beyond standard playbooks and continuously strengthening processes based on recurring themes and insights.
• Drive operational health and continuous improvement through weekly performance reviews and RCAs, with clear accountability for closing systemic gaps—not simply identifying them.
2. TA Operations & Systems Enablement
• Drive operational excellence across core TA processes, including interview scheduling, offer operations, onboarding readiness, and referrals—owning execution, governance, and continuous improvement.
• Own India TA systems governance as the SPOC and SME for Workday Recruiting, ServiceNow, Phenom CRM, and HackerRank, ensuring data integrity, access governance, and effective adoption.
• Lead capability building and enablement for Recruiters and TCs through structured process and systems training, including readiness for new tools, workflows, and rollouts.
• Drive TA technology enhancements in partnership with TechOps and GTAO, leading requirements validation, UAT, change readiness, and rollout support. • Strengthen process governance and audit readiness by maintaining SOPs, governing documentation and change requests, and ensuring robust audit trails. • Identify and solve operational gaps by proactively diagnosing process inefficiencies and developing scalable, automation-led improvements for TA leadership approval.
3. Vendor, Procurement & Compliance Governance
• Own end-to-end TA procurement operations, including PR/PO management, renewals, invoice tracking, SLA governance, and ROI monitoring across sourcing tools and TA vendors.
• Lead vendor governance and performance, proactively identifying, escalating, and resolving service, commercial, and operational risks.
• Drive cross-functional execution with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Vendor Management to ensure timely renewals, commercial discipline, and compliance.
• Serve as TA’s audit & compliance POC for SOX, statutory, equity, offer-governance, and data-privacy reviews, maintaining accurate and audit-ready documentation.
4. Stakeholder & Change Leadership
• Partner with Talent Partners, COEs, and TA leadership to design and execute process updates, training, and audit preparations.
• Lead adoption of new operating models (e.g., Interview Scheduling AI, ServiceNow workflow changes) through structured communication, training, and feedback loops. • Represent India TAO independently in global policy and system calibration sessions, ensuring regional compliance and scalability needs are represented and factored into global decisions.
• Mentor and provide guidance to Talent Coordinators and junior operations staff on process, systems, and compliance standards.

Required Skills & Capabilities
• Deep expertise in Talent Acquisition operations and end-to-end hiring workflows, with the ability to set standards, not just follow them.
• Strong working knowledge of Workday Recruiting or similar ATS platforms, including configuration, access governance, and troubleshooting.
• Proven experience owning interview scheduling, offer coordination, and onboarding processes at scale.
• Experience leading UAT, system rollouts, or process change initiatives. • Strong audit and compliance orientation — SOX, statutory, data privacy, and offer governance.
• Vendor and procurement management experience, including PO/PR workflows and SLA governance.
• Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills; comfortable representing the function in senior and global forums.
• High degree of ownership, judgment, and process discipline; ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
• Ability to mentor and enable junior team members and coordinators.

Required Experience & Qualifications

• 4–8 years of experience in TA Operations, Recruiting Operations, or Workforce Coordination, including demonstrated ownership of governance or compliance-sensitive processes.
• Proven experience operating in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder hiring environment (1,000+ annual hires preferred).
• Hands-on experience leading system implementations, UAT, or process change rollouts (required, not just exposure).

About the Role
Our team needs a Senior Program Manager to own end-to-end delivery of GenAI-powered features — from initial concept through architecture, build, launch, and scale. This is a hands-on, technically skilled PGM role. You will lead the roadmap and collaborate with engineers to develop system solutions. You will be accountable for adoption and results once the feature ships. You'll operate at the intersection of product strategy, applied AI architecture, and cross-functional execution.

What You'll Do
- Own the Feature Roadmap End-to-End — Define and lead the roadmap for GenAI-powered features from concept to launch, aligning scope and sequencing with business priorities. Make the call on model bets and platform direction at the feature level.
- Architect and Ship Agentic/RAG Systems — Lead and facilitate the design and delivery of the AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, and RAG pipelines underlying the feature, from prototype through production-grade deployment. Partner directly with engineering on system architecture, not just program tracking.
- Drive Adoption from Beta to Default — Own the process for go-to-market and adoption plan; run pilots, gather usage signals, iterate on feedback, and build the mechanisms that move the feature from experimental to default usage.

- Balance hands-on execution with leadership and prioritization

Strategy & Planning

- The team consistently delivers a small number of high-impact improvements

Our Company
Empowering everyone to create.
Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.
We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process. Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team
Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own brand should set the standard for how identity evolves in this new era. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Brand Design to define the future of Adobe's identity, ensure the best of the Adobe brand is consistently integrated into the AI systems and technology we build, and build the internal team, systems and culture that bring it to life. This is a role for a world-class brand designer, identity architect and systems builder with exceptional taste, craft and imagination.

You will own Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system across an increasingly complex portfolio of products, audiences, experiences, and surfaces. You will ensure the brand remains distinctive, coherent and unmistakably Adobe while continually evolving.

Working upstream, you will define the principles, visual codes and architecture of the brand. You will translate them into adaptive tools and machine-readable systems that can be applied consistently by internal teams, external partners, templates and AI-enabled workflows. Brand leadership at Adobe extends beyond static guidelines. It includes identity, typography, color, imagery, motion, digital behavior, spatial expression, portfolio architecture, governance and the role of AI in applying brands at scale.

The Head of Brand Design owns Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system, including the principles that govern visual and verbal identity. The Head of Design owns the design practice and visual expression across Adobe Creative's work; the Head of Copy owns the copywriting practice and creative expression of Adobe's verbal identity; and the Head of Campaigns owns the campaign platforms and central ideas that bring the brand to market. You partner closely with each to ensure the system enables distinctive creative expression without fragmenting the brand.

You are a maker first. You remain close to the tools, the teams and the work. Your authority comes from your taste, your judgment and the strength of the systems you build.

What You'll Do
Define Adobe's Brand for the New Era
- Own Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system.
- Establish a clear point of view on what a modern, adaptive global brand should be in the age of AI.
- Define the principles, visual codes and behaviors that make Adobe unmistakably Adobe.
- Own the governing principles of Adobe's verbal identity, naming architecture, nomenclature and tone of voice, partnering with the Head of Copy on creative application.
- Ensure the brand remains coherent across products, audiences and experiences without becoming rigid or predictable.
- Build a system capable of supporting both flagship creative expression and everyday execution.
- Continually evolve the brand based on culture, technology and the changing ways people create.

Build the Brand System Upstream
- Build the identity frameworks, tools and working practices that enable teams to make strong brand decisions from the start.
- Translate brand strategy into practical systems across typography, color, imagery, motion, composition, behavior and verbal principles.
- Create modular and adaptive tools that support speed, scale and creative flexibility.
- Move Adobe beyond static guidelines toward structured, machine-readable brand logic.
- Partner with Creative Technology, Product, Production and Operations to embed brand principles into tools and workflows.
- Turn learning from real-world applications into improvements to the system.

Lead Brand Expression Across Adobe
- Lead the development and evolution of Adobe's corporate, portfolio and product brand expression.
- Shape Adobe's most visible identity systems and brand expressions across products, campaigns and real-world moments.
- Partner with the Head of Design to ensure Adobe's identity system is interpreted with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination across Adobe Creative's work.
- Partner with the Head of Copy to translate Adobe's verbal identity, naming principles, nomenclature and tone of voice into distinctive creative expression across Adobe Creative's work.
- Partner with the Head of Campaigns to ensure campaign platforms stretch and advance the brand without fragmenting it.
- Partner with Content and Experiences leaders so Adobe's brand system supports publishing and real-world expression with clarity and flexibility.
- Ensure the system performs across digital, physical, spatial, motion and emerging AI-enabled surfaces.
- Hold externally produced brand-system work to the same standard as internal brand work.

Build a World-Class Brand Team
- Build and lead Adobe's in-house team of Brand Design Directors, Art Directors, Brand Systems Designers and Brand Designers.
- Build a strong leadership bench and clear pathways for makers to grow.
- Recruit exceptional brand designers with diverse perspectives, strong craft and rigorous systems thinking.
- Create a culture of high standards, experimentation, direct feedback and creative generosity.
- Keep senior brand leaders close to the work and protect meaningful time for making.
- Build flexible teams around identity, systems, expression and emerging brand needs.
- Reduce dependence on external agencies for Adobe's core brand thinking and creative authorship.

Advance AI-Native Brand Systems
- Define Adobe Creative's point of view on how AI changes identity, governance and brand application.
- Build brand systems that can be understood and applied by people, templates and AI-enabled workflows.
- Establish principles for evaluating AI-assisted brand output through distinctiveness, coherence, craft and human judgment.
- Define where automation can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.
- Partner with Product as a creative customer zero, testing how brand logic can be embedded into emerging tools and experiences.
- Ensure teams understand responsible AI, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Represent Brand Across Adobe
- Represent Adobe's brand system and identity in executive and cross-functional forums.
- Translate identity and brand decisions into clear, actionable choices.
- Advocate for brand to be involved earlier in product, portfolio and business decisions.
- Connect brand distinction and coherence to recognition, trust, preference and long-term value.
- Present work with clarity, confidence and conviction.

What You Need to Succeed
- 15+ years of experience in brand design, visual identity or multidisciplinary brand leadership.
- A world-class portfolio of identity systems for iconic global brands.
- Significant experience as a Design Partner, Executive Creative Director, Global Brand Design Director or equivalent.
- Meaningful industry recognition through D&AD, The One Show, ADC, Cannes Lions or equivalent.
- Exceptional taste, visual judgment and systems thinking.
- A track record of building identity systems that are both beautifully designed and operationally rigorous.
- Experience navigating portfolio architecture, product brands and complex global organizations.
- Experience building or significantly transforming an in-house brand capability.
- Deep expertise in identity, typography, color, image-making and motion, with strong fluency across digital, spatial and emerging brand practices.
- Experience developing modular, adaptive or machine-readable brand systems.
- Experience directing brand agencies, design studios and specialist partners.
- Deep fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and generative AI workflows.
- A clear point of view on how AI changes brand creation, governance and application.
- A commanding presenter who can communicate the value of brand to senior executives.
- A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, technology, art, fashion, entertainment and creator communities.
- A track record of building multidisciplinary teams, developing future brand leaders and maintaining a high standard through speed, ambiguity and change.
